name: [PROGRESSION] Pan for Gold
desc:
Become the richest person ever during a massive gold rush!

Welcome to Eureka Island, my dear player, where the water is conspicuously filled with resources. The art of prospecting is back, and you're first in line. Pan, drill, and collect until your insatiable greed is satisfied. Build your plot to work for you. Decorate your land with furniture you find in the river.  The Gold Rush has never been this satisfying.

Update Changelog:
- Join the Community Server for a FULL Update log, and join the group for 2x Luck!

Making a game like this takes a ton of time, if you enjoyed yourself please consider liking (👍)
